title: Validate STM32WL memory budget
description: Build minimal Zephyr+IPv6+CoAP on nucleo_wl55jc. Run west build -t ram_report and rom_report. Target: <50KB RAM, <220KB flash. If exceeded, evaluate RIOT OS fallback. This is a go/no-go gate for Zephyr on STM32WL.
close_reason: Already completed: Memory budget validated 2026-06-24 (documented in lichen/README.md). STM32WL55 nucleo_wl55jc uses 78KB flash + 30KB RAM for Zephyr base, leaving ~140KB flash + ~20KB RAM for LICHEN protocol - well within <220KB flash/<50KB RAM targets. No RIOT fallback needed.
